property_summary: For any caller, only the owner can successfully execute sudicideAnyone and self-destruct the contract; the bug allows any non-owner to do so.
After a call to sudicideAnyone by a non-owner, the correct contract always reverts, while the mutant never reverts.

Anyone (including non-owners) can call sudicideAnyone on the reference, but only the owner should succeed; the buggy version allows any caller to succeed, so the rule is that a call by a non-owner must revert, which the bug breaks.

After any call to sudicideAnyone() by the owner, the contract must be destroyed (code size zero); the buggy version fails to enforce the only-owner restriction, allowing a non-owner to destroy it for some caller the fuzzer finds.
For any owner call, after selfdestruct the contract's balance must have moved to the caller, but the mutant sends funds to a different address instead.
